ideas.pitch: A web-based dashboard utilizing lightweight pretrained computer vision and RAG to monitor local water body images and sensor reports for early contamination warnings.
ideas.problem_statement: UN Sustainable Development Goal 6: Clean Water and Sanitation - Real-world water pollution detection and monitoring.
ideas.title: AquaSense SDG 6: Real-Time Water Quality & Contamination Early Warning System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with UN SDG 6 and features a clear, measurable impact on public health, matching the winning environmental monitoring pattern from the AquaSense IoT Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile web application that allows farmers to upload crop leaf photos for instant disease identification and localized climate risk analysis using multimodal vision models.
ideas.problem_statement: UN Sustainable Development Goal 2: Zero Hunger - Addressing agricultural productivity constraints and food security challenges.
ideas.title: AgriGuard SDG 2: Crop Disease and Yield Risk Assessment Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon a proven hackathon winner concept from Reboot Earth by focusing on tangible food security metrics and actionable advice for local farmers.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight digital twin dashboard that tracks university department power usage, predicting peak loads and recommending energy conservation rules via a localized RAG engine.
ideas.problem_statement: UN Sustainable Development Goal 7: Affordable and Clean Energy - Improving energy efficiency and reducing institutional carbon footprints.
ideas.title: EcoGrid SDG 7: Campus Energy Consumption Optimization & Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the successful digital twin and predictive visualization patterns that secured 1st place at the Energy A.I. Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A crowdsourced platform that aggregates local infrastructural complaints, categorizes them using text-embedding clustering, and maps high-priority municipal hazards for rapid civic response.
ideas.problem_statement: UN Sustainable Development Goal 11: Sustainable Cities and Communities - Addressing urban resilience and localized infrastructure maintenance.
ideas.title: UrbanShield SDG 11: Community Hazard and Infrastructure Damage Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features automated geospatial risk triage which mimics award-winning infrastructure inspection systems by prioritizing urgent civic interventions.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered RAG tool that instantly converts complex technical or regional government educational documents into simplified local language summaries and interactive quiz modules.
ideas.problem_statement: UN Sustainable Development Goal 4: Quality Education - Democratizing access to inclusive learning materials for underprivileged regions.
ideas.title: EduAccess SDG 4: Multilingual Inclusive Learning Curriculum RAG Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses educational equity with an easily demonstrable RAG pipeline that judges can test live with their own documents within the strict 8-hour timeframe.
